answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 63218 Country: India Title: What is the difference between halal and jhatka meat? Question: I want to know that what is the difference between halal and jhatka meat? Please explain it. Answer ID: 63218 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 294/294/B=04/1437) An animal that a Muslim slaughters by reciting the name of Allah is called halal. And animal that is slaughtered by a Muslim but without reciting the name of Allah as well as the animal that is slaughtered by a non-Muslim both are called jhatka (haram); such animal becomes haram and it is not lawful to consume its meat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
